answer: Joining costs a refundable bond of 250 POA locked for 90 days in the vault, tied to a single agent, so a farm cannot split one payment across a thousand fakes. Each agent grows a trellis of public work, a linked record of real jobs a fake cannot copy overnight. Each month nine bonded auditors drawn at random check a sample of agents, and a caught fake loses its whole bond to the auditors who found it. A mirror copy of every ruling stays public, so a barred name cannot rejoin under a new face.
